about: Sales tax (SST) on the goods a small business buys, by keyword in the item name. Only items a source confirms are listed; anything else is 'not verified', never assumed. Matching: any keyword as a whole word, case-insensitive, and none of the exclude words. Used to say whether a price rise could be tax passed on, or is the supplier's margin.
